title: Eastern Chalukyas: wars, more titles, inscriptions, temples

boxes.title: Rashtrakuta wars
head: Ruler
Rival / event
rows: Conflict begins with **Dantidurga** (Vengi had helped Badami)
Backed **Govinda III**; beaten by ==**Dhruva**==, who married his daughter **Sheela Mahadevi**: kingdom saved

boxes.title: Later rivals
items: **Jatachoda Bhima** (Telugu Choda of **Pedakallu**) occupied Vengi; Danarnava's sons fled to **Rajaraja Chola**
**1006**: Satyasraya sent **Bayyalanambi**; Saktivarma's coins found in ==**Arakan (Burma)**==
Succession war: Rajaraja Narendra backed by **Rajendra I**; Vijayaditya VII by Kalyani **Jayasimha II**
Vimaladitya's other wife **Melama** = daughter of Jatachoda Bhima

boxes.title: More rulers & titles
head: Ruler

rows: Throne back from **Kokkili** (→ **Yalamanchili** kingdom); ==**Mushikonda**== to Jains

boxes.title: Temples & religion
items: **Vengi school**: Dravida style, local sandstone, raised **jagati**; Buddhist influence
Rajaraja Narendra: **Kalidindi** three Shiva temples (fallen Chola soldiers)
**Kapalikas** from the **Misra Saivam** school; **Potla Cheruvu**: Jain centre
